---
title: Red Onion Monferrina
id: MAR-0024
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 6
time_min: 45
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g crescenza cheese
- 0.5 fresh red bell pepper
- 0.5 dried red chili
- 1 fresh spring onion
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 1 teaspoon sweet paprika
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Peel the bell pepper, cut it into small pieces, and put it in the blender.
2. Add the crumbled dried red chili, the sliced spring onion, the oil, the paprika, the lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
3. Blend the ingredients and mix the mixture into the crescenza cheese.
4. Stir to obtain a smooth cream, which you will keep in the refrigerator until serving.
